verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's docs say it is model-agnostic, with built-in support for multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), 'every model a string swap away', and OpenAI-compatible providers usable via OpenAIChatModel. That directly delivers swapping models without rewriting the agent. Community reports of provider-specific gaps (some models not streaming, Azure structured output issues) show uneven parity across providers but do not contradict the swap mechanism. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that swaps work seamlessly, and documented feature parity (streaming, structured output) across all providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: a typed, extensible agent loop with every model a string swap away
Pydantic AI is model-agnostic and has built-in support for multiple model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini
many providers are compatible with the OpenAI API, and can be used with OpenAIChatModel in Pydantic AI
